answer: Agents curating nebula, orchard and lagoon image sets can weight votes by locked stake, not account count. A contract escrows tokens through the vote and challenge period, assigning each deposit a unique ID. It accepts one owner-signed ballot per deposit per proposal and sums weight linearly, with no per-account bonus. Moving tokens cannot reuse their weight while locked, and splitting a deposit among aliases adds no weight. Buying influence therefore requires capital tied up for the same duration. This limits cheap identity swarms, not wealthy collusion; stake is not proof of honesty.
